stem: The top and bottom bars of a gate in Colombo, Sri Lanka, are parallel. A straight diagonal brace connects the two bars and makes a \(41^{\circ}\) angle with the bottom bar, as shown. What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Angle \(BAC\) and angle \(ACE\) lie between the parallel bars on the same side of the brace, so they are same-side interior angles.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This treats the two angles as alternate interior angles, which are equal. Angle \(x^{\circ}\) is on the same side of the brace as the \(41^{\circ}\) angle, so the two angles are supplementary.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(90 - 41\), which treats the angles as complementary.
explanation.C: Correct. Same-side interior angles are supplementary: \(180 - 41 = 139\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(90 + 41\); the angles add up to \(180^{\circ}\), so \(x = 180 - 41\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'A': 'A', 'B': 'B', 'D': 'C', 'C': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'A', 'B': 'B', 'C': 'D', 'D': 'C'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert P['A'][1]==P['B'][1] and P['D'][1]==P['E'][1]
assert abs(ang('B','A','C')-41)<0.1
ans=180-41
assert abs(ang('A','C','E')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==139
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
